warmup_rule: effective_beta = beta * min(1, epoch / kl_warmup_epochs) with epoch 1-based; kl_warmup_epochs 0 uses beta from epoch 1
loss_definition: batch mean of (sum of squared errors over 128 coordinates + effective_beta * KL). KL is the diagonal Gaussian closed form, also averaged over the batch. effective_beta reaches the configured beta at epoch kl_warmup_epochs.
protocol: One validation cut of the train split is shared by every member. Its seed is the dataset seed. Each model seed sets initialization and batch order only. Calibration and test rows are not used.
selection: lowest validation loss among epochs at the full target beta (epoch >= kl_warmup_epochs); the earliest epoch wins a tie
